name: Bag Lookout
summary: Keeps a small count of your free bag slots on screen and gives one clear alert before your bags run out of room.

description: **Bag Lookout shows how many bag slots you have left and warns you once before your bags are full.**
## Features
- A small counter such as "Bags 12/98" that turns yellow when space gets low and red when no slot is left.
- One message in the middle of the screen with a sound when you reach your warning point, and one more at zero.
- No spam while looting: it warns again only after you make room.
- The reagent bag is counted on its own; click the counter to see it.
## How to use
Drag the counter where you like it. Type `/bl` (or `/baglookout`) to see the current state and all commands.
## In detail
### The free bag slots counter

The counter adds up the free and total slots of your backpack and equipped bags. It is white while you have room, yellow at or below your warning point and red when no slot is left. Profession bags are left out, like in the game's own free-slot count. It refreshes after every bag change.
### The bag full warning

When your free slots drop to the warning point (5 by default), a yellow line appears where the game shows its error messages, with the raid warning sound. When the last slot is used, a red "Your bags are full!" follows. Then it stays quiet while you loot and arms again only once you have more free slots than the warning point. Logging in, reloading or changing the warning point never warns about the bags as they already are.
### The reagent bag

The reagent bag has its own count and never triggers a warning. Click the counter to open a second line such as "Reagents 8/36", coloured with the same rule; click again to close it. Without a reagent bag the line says so.
### Commands
- `/bl` – shows free slots, warning point, sound and counter state.
- `/bl threshold 8` – sets the warning point, a whole number from 0 to 50.
- `/bl lock` – locks or unlocks the counter in place.
- `/bl hide` and `/bl show` – hide or show the counter.
- `/bl sound on` or `off` – switches the warning sound.
## Good to know
- Works on Retail only.
- The bank is not counted, only the bags you carry.
- Warnings stay on while the counter is hidden.
- The addon is in English.
- It saves only its settings and the counter position, shared by all your characters, until you delete the saved data.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
